title: Florida Woman Attacks Boyfriend After Smoking ‘Meth or Flakka’: Cops
description:
A Florida woman was arrested after police were called to a motel in Boca Raton, Florida over an alleged argument between her and her boyfriend. Police took Amanda Teixeira, 29, into custody after a witness told police she was seen slapping the man. The victim went on to explain Amanda had also thrown a lamp towards him in the alleged argument. While interviewing the victim, Amanda was seen by officers at a distance before they quickly caught up with her and got her side of the story. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
